assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers.

assumptions.statement: site_boundary and key_areas use repository provisional rough polygons (provisional_rough).
assumptions.impact: All precision-sensitive metrics must be recalculated when official polygons arrive; provisional geometry is not an official redline.

assumptions.statement: Silicon-based agent carriers are accounted as device-type structures sharing land with human activity ('carbon-silicon shared land'), not as conventional floor area.
assumptions.impact: Translation and measurement of engineering approval indicators are delegated to physical-space competition teams; concept requires professional and statutory validation.

assumptions.statement: Tiered compute invocation (L1 token / L2 community card / L3 500m zone / L4 tower direct) is proposed as a governance and operating mechanism, not as committed utility infrastructure.
assumptions.impact: Implementation requires operators, regulator involvement, and exit mechanisms; wording avoids 'fourth utility' claims.

assumptions.statement: Time-folding (daytime human activity, nighttime agent self-operation) informs phasing, right-of-way, and public-space design.
assumptions.impact: Nighttime operations require safety governance and noise regulation before implementation.

assumptions.statement: Signature indicators (interaction-box density, 20m circle coverage, tiered-compute coverage, corpus-station density) are conceptual targets pending operation data.
assumptions.impact: They are reported through prose, figures, and assumptions; they never enter the three formal core visual metrics.

assumptions.statement: 'Silicon-Carbon City' tested 0 collisions against a snapshot of 1,100 submitted titles on 2026-08-29. This is a title-search snapshot only and does not constitute trademark, copyright, multilingual-name, or city-brand availability review; a fresh search and rights verification are required before formal adoption.
assumptions.impact: The name result is treated as a time-point snapshot; re-run the search and complete rights checks before any formal brand adoption; differentiate from word-family neighbor 'Luoduo Agent City' in the PR description.

assumptions.statement: US AI funding and valuation figures (2025 global AI funding ~US$211bn; Bay Area ~50% of US AI investment; Anthropic ~US$61bn valuation) are quoted from public reporting and require cross-check before citation.
assumptions.impact: Figures are used as directional benchmarks only; exact numbers must be re-verified from latest primary sources.

assumptions.statement: Some trees and landscapes may require relocation and optimization; estimates are scenario-based and registered here.
assumptions.impact: No tree removal or relocation is committed; quantities require field survey.

assumptions.statement: The ride-shed expansion ring (communities, universities, TOD stations) is a research suggestion ring beyond the official 11.4 km2 boundary.
assumptions.impact: The expansion ring is annotated in figures and does not change official scope data.
